import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def mat(name, col):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs[0].default_value = col
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    m.diffuse_color = col
    return m

wood = mat("Wood", (0.45, 0.26, 0.12, 1))
wood_dark = mat("Wood Dark", (0.30, 0.16, 0.07, 1))

def make(name, boxes, material, loc=(0,0,0), rot_z=0):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz) in boxes:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((cx, cy, cz)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((sx, sy, sz, 1)))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    me.materials.append(material)
    old = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if old: bpy.data.objects.remove(old)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler.z = rot_z
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 1.0 top at 0.75 m
L, W, H, T, leg = 1.6, 1.0, 0.75, 0.05, 0.07
boxes = [(0, 0, H - T/2, L, W, T)]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        boxes.append((sx*(L/2-0.1), sy*(W/2-0.1), (H-T)/2, leg, leg, H-T))
# aprons
boxes.append((0, W/2-0.1, H-T-0.05, L-0.2, 0.03, 0.1))
boxes.append((0, -(W/2-0.1), H-T-0.05, L-0.2, 0.03, 0.1))
boxes.append((L/2-0.1, 0, H-T-0.05, 0.03, W-0.2, 0.1))
boxes.append((-(L/2-0.1), 0, H-T-0.05, 0.03, W-0.2, 0.1))
make("Table", boxes, wood)

# Chair in local space: front faces +Y (toward table), backrest at -Y
S, SH, ST, cl = 0.45, 0.45, 0.04, 0.04
cb = [(0, 0, SH - ST/2, S, S, ST)]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        cb.append((sx*(S/2-cl/2), sy*(S/2-cl/2), (SH-ST)/2, cl, cl, SH-ST))
# back posts and slats
for sx in (-1, 1):
    cb.append((sx*(S/2-cl/2), -(S/2-cl/2), SH + 0.22, cl, cl, 0.44))
cb.append((0, -(S/2-cl/2), SH + 0.40, S, 0.03, 0.08))
cb.append((0, -(S/2-cl/2), SH + 0.24, S-2*cl, 0.025, 0.06))

# positions: two on long sides, one on each end
placements = [
    ("Chair 1", (0, -(W/2 + 0.25), 0), 0),            # faces +Y
    ("Chair 2", (0, (W/2 + 0.25), 0), math.pi),
    ("Chair 3", (-(L/2 + 0.25), 0, 0), -math.pi/2),   # faces +X
    ("Chair 4", ((L/2 + 0.25), 0, 0), math.pi/2),
]
for n, loc, r in placements:
    make(n, cb, wood_dark, loc, r)

# ground
if not bpy.data.objects.get("Floor"):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=8, location=(0,0,0))
    bpy.context.active_object.name = "Floor"
    bpy.context.active_object.data.materials.append(mat("Floor", (0.6,0.6,0.58,1)))
print([o.name for o in bpy.data.objects])
